description: This file defines a service class for interacting with the Gutendex (Project Gutenberg) API, providing methods to search books, retrieve book details, and obtain download links.

classes.name: GutendexService
classes.description: Service class encapsulating methods for searching and fetching data from the Gutendex API.

methods.description: Performs a search query on Gutendex with pagination, returning a list of book summaries.

methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific book given its ID.
